title: Eric Walker on TRW board

tellings.quote: interesting fact about TRW Jacques Valet has talked about Dr. Eric A. Walker we talked about earlier being a on the board of directors or a chairman of TRW as well.

plain: An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb says that Jacques Vallee, a well known UFO researcher, has talked about a man named Dr. Eric A. Walker sitting on the board of directors, or serving as chairman, of TRW, an American defense and aerospace company. UAPGerb offers it as an interesting link between Walker, who comes up elsewhere in UFO stories, and the defense industry.
